## Expanded question bank

[Open the expanded bank reader](assets/expanded-bank.html) and choose your authorized `ap_statistics_question_bank.json` file. Filter by topic, source, or question type, then try a question before revealing its answer. The reader opens the file on your device. If your package includes figures, extract it first and select the extracted `assets` folder in the reader.

## Skill dependency map

[Explore the skill dependency map](assets/dependency-map.html) to see what to review before tackling a topic. Try searching for **joint probability**, then trace its prerequisites back to reading a two-way table and finding a part-to-whole fraction. The map opens directly and includes explanations and source references for the learning links. Choose **Find practice for this skill** on a linked skill to open the reader with that skill selected when you load your bank.
